authorized-by.reason: v0.3 Phase 2 / change #E foundation: introduce discussions table for gatekeeper+architect intent capture; add task_spec_path column on tasks so SQLite knows where the on-disk markdown spec lives. All later Phase 2 tasks depend on this schema being in place.

task.title: Add discussions table and task_spec_path column; bump schema_version 3 → 4
task.description:
Phase 2 makes SQLite the canonical state and degrades the file system to a snapshot layer. Two schema gaps block that:
1. `issues` exists but `discussions` does NOT. We need it to capture the conversational alignment that GOALS.md + DISCUSSION.md used to hold. 2. `tasks` has no pointer to the on-disk markdown spec. The new flow has SWE read `docs/trustmybot/tasks/<branch_id>.md` AND mutate the matching `tasks` row by `branch_id`. Storing the resolved path in the row makes reverse lookups (DB → file) cheap and eliminates path-derivation drift.
Add the `discussions` table:
```sql CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discussions ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id), author TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'human' | 'gatekeeper' | 'architect' | etc. kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'note', -- 'intent' | 'question' | 'answer' | 'decision' | 'note' body_md TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_discussions_issue_created ON discussions(issue_id, created_at); ```
Add column to `tasks`:
```sql ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN task_spec_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; ```
Bump `plugin_meta.schema_version` from 3 → 4 and update the `INSERT OR IGNORE` seed at the bottom of schema.sql to `(4, '0.3.0-alpha')`.
Apply the same changes via the migration runner so existing databases pick them up. Inspect `mcp/trajectory-server/src/db.ts` (or whichever file owns `applyMigrations` / schema bootstrap) to find the migration pattern v0.2 → v0.3 used for `file_registry`, `plugin_config`, `identity`, `regen_state`. Mirror it: detect `schema_version < 4`, run the new CREATE/ALTER, write the new version row.
Add a TypeScript type for `Discussion` in `mcp/trajectory-server/src/types.ts` matching the new columns.
NO new MCP tools in this task — those land in `phase-2-mcp-discussions-and-snapshot.xml`. This task is schema-only so it can be tested in isolation.

files.file: Append the `discussions` CREATE TABLE + index near the existing `roundtables` block (logical neighbour). Add the `tasks.task_spec_path` column on the `tasks` CREATE TABLE statement (so a fresh-init DB has it from the start). Bump the seed `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO plugin_meta` values from `(3, '0.3.0-alpha')` to `(4, '0.3.0-alpha')`.

Locate the migration / version-bump block (the same one that introduced `file_registry`, `plugin_config`, `identity`, `regen_state` for v3). Add a v3 → v4 step that runs: - `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discussions (...)` (verbatim from above) - `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_discussions_issue_created ON discussions(issue_id, created_at)` - `ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN task_spec_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` — guarded by `PRAGMA table_info(tasks)` check so re-runs do not throw "duplicate column" on an already-migrated DB. - Insert/update `plugin_meta` to schema_version=4. If `db.ts` does not own migrations directly, follow the import chain to the file that does and edit there.

Add `Discussion` interface with fields: id: number; issue_id: number; author: string; kind: string; body_md: string; created_at: string. Add `task_spec_path: string` to the existing `Task` interface so callers compile against the new column. Default-empty handling stays in the SQL column DEFAULT.

task.success-criteria: - `schema.sql` contains a `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discussions` block with the exact 6 columns above plus the index. - `schema.sql` `tasks` CREATE TABLE includes `task_spec_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`. - `schema.sql` seed row reads `(4, '0.3.0-alpha')`. - The migration runner upgrades a v3 DB to v4 idempotently — running twice does not error on duplicate column / duplicate table. - `types.ts` exports `Discussion` and `Task` types matching the new schema. - `npm --prefix mcp/trajectory-server run build` succeeds with no TS errors. - Test DB freshly initialized from `schema.sql` reports `schema_version = 4` and contains the `discussions` table and the `tasks.task_spec_path` column.
task.out-of-scope: - Writing MCP tools that read/write the new table (Phase 2 task `mcp-discussions-and-snapshot`). - Removing `goals_md` / `goals_md_hash` columns from `issues` (deferred — keep the columns even though we no longer write GOALS.md as a file; `goals_md` becomes the catch-all `objective` summary). - Hook updates that query the new tables (Phase 2 task `hook-sqlite-migration`). - Backfilling `task_spec_path` for any existing rows — fresh tasks only.
task.verification:
From `/Users/Zax/Git/GitHub/TMB/plugin/` (inside the worktree):
```bash # Schema text checks grep -q 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discussions' mcp/trajectory-server/src/schema.sql && echo "OK: discussions block" grep -q 'idx_discussions_issue_created' mcp/trajectory-server/src/schema.sql && echo "OK: index" grep -q 'task_spec_path' mcp/trajectory-server/src/schema.sql && echo "OK: column on tasks" grep -q "(4, '0.3.0-alpha')" mcp/trajectory-server/src/schema.sql && echo "OK: schema_version bump"
# TS build npm --prefix mcp/trajectory-server run build && echo "OK: build clean"
# Fresh-init DB integrity TMP_DB=$(mktemp /tmp/trajXXXXXX.db) sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" < mcp/trajectory-server/src/schema.sql sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" "SELECT schema_version FROM plugin_meta;" | grep -q '^4$' && echo "OK: schema_version=4" sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" ".schema discussions" | grep -q 'body_md' && echo "OK: discussions table created" sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" "PRAGMA table_info(tasks);" | grep -q 'task_spec_path' && echo "OK: tasks.task_spec_path" rm -f "$TMP_DB"
# Idempotent migration: spin a v3-style DB then run migration twice # (Implementation detail per db.ts pattern; verify no error on second run.) ```
All checks must print OK. The migration idempotency check is the load-bearing one — re-running on an already-migrated DB MUST NOT throw.
task.commit:
🗄️ feat(schema): add discussions table + tasks.task_spec_path; bump schema_version to 4
Phase 2 prerequisite: SQLite becomes canonical state for the conversational intent that GOALS.md / DISCUSSION.md used to hold (discussions table), and each task row knows where its on-disk markdown spec lives (task_spec_path). Migration is guarded for idempotency on existing v3 databases.

results.summary: Added discussions table + idx_discussions_issue_created index, task_spec_path column to tasks, bumped schema_version seed to 4 in schema.sql; added applyV3ToV4 in-place migration (idempotency guarded by PRAGMA table_info column check); bumped TARGET_VERSION to 4 in db.ts; added Discussion interface and task_spec_path to Task in types.ts. Updated 4 test files to reflect new table count (14), version (4), and added 2 new migration tests (g + h) covering v3→v4 in-place and idempotency.
